prompt:
Workflow step: Use the fixed robot arm to pick up the test tube from tray and move it to capping device to screw on the test tube cap.
Inspection timing: after this step
Inspection location: capping device
What the inspection checks: Check near capping device whether the test tube on the gripper has been screwed on.

A description of the inspection camera's photograph follows, written by someone who was not told what is being checked.

Description: The photo shows a close-up of automated laboratory hardware. Center-left: a black carbon-fibre panel supporting a vertical metal column with a silver plate at top; below it a dark orange/red gripper or cap-handling head extends downward.

Directly beneath this head, held in a black bracket, stands an upright cylindrical plastic vial or tube with an orange screw cap. The cap is on the vial, and the vial body contains a pink/red liquid filling most of it.

Right side: a black metal stage or rail assembly with silver blocks, a small blue indicator light, and a silver-grey instrument housing with a green base, labelled with partly visible lettering ("ROBOTICS"). Background is a plain white wall and pale benchtop.
observations: The photograph confirms the test tube is held in the bracket with the orange screw cap successfully screwed onto the vial.

args.observations: The photograph confirms the test tube is held in the bracket with the orange screw cap successfully screwed onto the vial.
